problem:
Find the entry ${c}_{24}$ of the matrix $C$, where 

$$
C=[\begin{aligned}0 & 1 & 2 & 4 \\ -1 & 2 & -3 & 5 \\ 2 & 1 & -3 & 4\end{aligned}].
$$
worked_solution:
The entry ${c}_{24}$ should lie at the intersection of the $2$nd row and $4$th column. Therefore, ${c}_{24}=5.$

$$
C=[\begin{aligned}0 & 1 & 2 & 4 \\ -1 & 2 & -3 & 5 \\ 2 & 1 & -3 & 4\end{aligned}]
$$
